prompt: High-fidelity desktop web app UI design mockup, landscape 1536x1024, of the Social page in "Monochrome", a self-hosted music streaming app shared by a small circle of friends. This is a usable product interface, not a poster, not a photograph of a screen, not a marketing site. Dark theme. App shell: near-black #0a0a0a window with rounded 14px charcoal blocks separated by 8px gutters. Left sidebar block 210px wide: tiny logo of two overlapping squares plus "Monochrome" wordmark, nav items Music, Library, Social (selected, subtle highlight), Listening stats; a "Recents" label with three small pill chips Playlists, Albums, Artists; Upload and Settings at the bottom. Bottom player bar block 76px tall across the full width: small cover thumbnail of Currents by Tame Impala, "Let It Happen" / "Tame Impala", shuffle, previous, play, next, repeat, thin progress bar 1:48 / 7:47, volume slider. The main content block fills the rest and holds the Social page. Clean neutral sans (Inter-like) for UI text. Real content only, spelled exactly as given. Visual world "The Booth" (same as the approved comp): the grammar of professional DJ deck displays translated into a social music page — matte black ground, members shown as circular album-cover jog-wheel discs inside dark platters with a thin progress ring in the cover color and a small white position marker near the rim, waveform overview strips tinted with the cover colors, square white cue brackets marking snippet ranges, condensed tabular numerals for times, a small green dot only for live members, soft diffuse glow of the cover colors spilling onto the black ground. Color comes only from album art; chrome is black, charcoal and white. No glassmorphism, no neon overload, no grid of cards. THIS FRAME SHOWS THE FEED VIEW WITH A DIFFERENT HIERARCHY. Header row: "Social" title, green dot "2 listening · 3 online", quiet tabs Feed (active, underlined) and Messages with a small "2" badge. HERO, about 360px tall, split asymmetrically: LEFT 58 percent is one featured deck — a single large 280px spinning cover disc for "Luna" playing "Breathe Deeper — Tame Impala" (cover: orange-red retro desert room) with its progress ring, beside it the name plate "Luna", a green live dot, the track title in large type, the artist, and under them the full track waveform overview spanning the width, tinted orange and red, with a white vertical playhead at 2:41 of 4:03 and the times in tabular numerals; two pill buttons "Listen along" (primary, white) and "Message". RIGHT 42 percent is the rest of the booth as a compact shelf of smaller decks in two rows ordered by recency: row one "Jon Bell — Midnight City · M83" (live, 120px disc, blue glow) and "admin — Breathe Deeper · 2 h ago" (smaller, dimmer); row two smaller still and desaturated "suiveurtag — Picture in my mind · 2 wk ago", "Mara Vale — 2 mo ago", then tiny avatar-only discs Noah, tester2, Inez Park, and a dashed empty disc "You · Share what you're playing". Below the hero, a slim composer "What are you listening to?" with music and image icons and a "Post" button. Then the feed as a track log with a left gutter of tabular times: section label "Your circle · 3 posts"; Luna "This album hit different at 3AM" with an album strip "Currents — Tame Impala · 2015" and its waveform tinted purple and orange, heart 2, comments 2; Noah "the homelab FLAC upgrade is audible. no notes."; Jon Bell "Found a bassline that refuses to sit still." with a waveform strip with white cue brackets 0:42 – 1:12.
